svg.text: HR-V0 GUARD / RECEIVER PRELIMINARY SPACE STUDY
NO PANEL, FRAME, FASTENER, RECEIVER OR CLEARANCE IS RELEASED
The orange envelope includes provisional 25 mm stopping, 25 mm clearance and 5 mm tolerance reservations.
Measured stopping/drop/sweep evidence governs. Increase the enclosure if any released case exceeds this space claim.
FRONT VIEW - SHOULDER-CENTERED
BLUE DASH: 360 mm object-center reach ceiling
ORANGE: 450 mm preliminary radial envelope
GUARD INSIDE: 900 W x 950 H mm
SHOULDER DATUM: 500 mm above bench
CATCH SPACE: 820 x 320 x 50 mm
25 mm stopping travel is NOT measured.
It is not an acceptance limit.
Final guard requires complete 3D sweep,
access probe, impact and retention proof,
panel support, service isolation and drop tests.
PLAN VIEW - PRELIMINARY INTERNAL DEPTH
GUARD INSIDE DEPTH: 400 mm provisional
CATCH INSIDE PLAN: 820 x 320 mm
Front panel shown as tool-removable only.
No door interlock is selected or credited.
PRELIMINARY - NOT A FABRICATION DRAWING OR PERMISSION TO ENERGIZE
